config.title: Processing Settings
config.hint: These settings apply to this audio processing job.
config.backend_help: Used for full mixes and post-separation track conversion
config.muscriptor_help: Pinned Large / Medium / Small public weights
config.muscriptor_instruments_help: Standard stem names prefill removable candidates; leave empty for model auto-detection.
config.muscriptor_chain_help: The official path keeps v0.3.0 segment behavior; the continuity-fix path joins sustained notes across segments to reduce boundary cuts or overlaps
config.track_layout_help: Multi-track keeps model groups; single-track merges the layout
config.tempo_help: Beat evidence is detected by Beat This final0, while tempo publication follows the selected mode: Auto writes one BPM; Follow source writes a phase-bounded Tempo Map; Manual keeps the same musical ticks and uses the selected BPM
config.bpm_help: Used in manual mode; the MIDI contains one tempo event
config.quantize_notes_help: When explicitly enabled, paired note starts and durations on every generated MIDI track snap to the selected grid. Disabled by default
config.quantize_grid_help: Choose 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, or 1/64; default 1/32. Changing this selector does not start a conversion
config.compute_help: Full workflows require NVIDIA CUDA or Intel XPU; CPU is outside the supported runtime
action.delete_job_confirm: Delete this job, its track child jobs, and every retained input/output file? This cannot be undone.
result.title: Processing result
result.completed: Processing is complete and the file passed its integrity check.
result.separation_completed: The WAV stems are ready; each track can be converted to MIDI separately.
result.failed: Processing failed and no file is available to download.
result.cancelled: The job stopped; incomplete files are not offered for download.
result.failure_help: The error above identifies the cause. Processing can be tried again after the environment or settings are corrected.
result.cancelled_help: The original audio remains available to process again or delete.
result.sheet_music_ready: The score ZIP is ready and its download has started.
result.warning.empty_midi: The MIDI file is valid, but the selected model did not detect any notes.
result.warning.note_count_corrected_from: The displayed note count was recalculated from the final MIDI file.
result.warning.help: The file remains downloadable. Listening to it can help determine whether another model better suits this track.
mixer.title: Multitrack audio workbench
mixer.manual_note: Each track can enable MIDI, select a model, and start its own conversion.
mixer.downloads: Converted files appear in the result section
track.midi_missing: MIDI conversion completed without creating a file
track.select_route_first: MIDI conversion is not enabled or no model is selected.
track.no_source: This track has no audio file available for conversion
error.sheet_music_missing: The service did not return the matching score ZIP.
dialog.title: Processing service address
dialog.hint: The frontend connects to the processing service over HTTP. Saving immediately tests the connection.
dialog.test_idle: The address changed; the connection test has not run yet.
dialog.health_invalid: The service returned an unrecognized status
route.smart: The selected multi-instrument model transcribes the full mix. Recognized notes stay unchanged, while tempo and meter use the shared detection result.
route.vocal_split: Leap XE and PolarFormer produce vocals and accompaniment WAV files. Start any MIDI conversion per track.
route.six_stem_split: BS-RoFormer SW Fixed delivers six independent WAV files, then opens the shared multitrack workbench.
route.piano_transkun: TransKun V2 provides dedicated piano transcription; an unavailable model is reported as an error.
route.piano_transkun_v2_aug: TransKun V2 Aug uses the official augmented checkpoint for piano transcription; an unavailable model is reported as an error.
route.piano_aria_amt: Aria-AMT provides dedicated piano transcription; recognized notes stay unchanged and use the detected tempo.
route.piano_bytedance_pedal: ByteDance piano transcription with sustain-pedal CC64 events preserved.
error.route_locked: Modes cannot be switched while a job is running.
error.api_version_mismatch: Incompatible {source} API version: this page needs {expected}, while the service returned {actual}
error.event_stream: The progress connection for job {id} was interrupted and is reconnecting.
error.read_jobs: Job history could not be read: {error}
